result.title: Drone-PUR: From Visual Clue Discovery to Understanding and Reasoning in UAV Scenes
result.summary: The reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) can be limited by incomplete or inaccurate visual observations in the general domain. In unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) scenes, small targets, subtle attributes, and changing viewpoints further complicate perception and understanding. Therefore, we introduce Drone-PUR, a dataset and benchmark organized around visual clue discovery, interpretation, and integration, corresponding to the three capability dimensions of perception, understanding, and reasoning. Reasoning samples are designed to require models to combine multiple visual clues to derive visually grounded conclusions. Its 11 tasks provide 175k training and 20k test samples spanning single images, image sequences, cross-modal images, and multiple viewpoints. All test samples undergo human review. Evaluating 22 general-purpose VLMs reveals persistent limitations in spatial judgment and cross-modal and cross-view reasoning. Across models, stronger perception is associated with better reasoning, while single-task fine-tuning further reveals selective bidirectional transfer between these capabilities. To examine domain adaptation, we develop UAV-PUR from Qwen3-VL through staged fine-tuning with auxiliary supervision. Its 4B and 8B variants improve overall multiple-choice accuracy by 18.33 and 17.52 percentage points over their pretrained counterparts, respectively. The dataset and project resources are available at https://drone-pur.github.io.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Drone-PUR，一个面向无人机场景的 VLM 数据集与基准，按视觉线索发现、解释与整合组织 11 项任务（175k 训练、20k 测试），评测 22 个通用 VLM，并分阶段微调得到 UAV-PUR 4B/8B。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「线索发现→理解→推理」任务构造及感知与推理双向迁移分析，可为核查视觉细节是否被保留并用于答案提供诊断参考；但材料未涉及 latent 状态生成，且任务场景偏 UAV 专用，故先列为待核查。
